identity.professional_headline: Technical Operations | Product Support | REST API Troubleshooting | AI Product Builder

professional_identity.mission: I help Product and Engineering teams reduce technical uncertainty by transforming ambiguous system problems into evidence-based engineering decisions.
professional_identity.approach: Through deep technical investigation, bug reproduction and root cause analysis, I enable teams to resolve the right problem faster, de-risk product rollouts, and build confidence across Engineering, Product and Customer Operations.

professional_superpowers.name: Reduce Technical Uncertainty
professional_superpowers.description: Transforms ambiguous technical incidents into structured, evidence-based investigations that support better decisions.

professional_superpowers.name: De-risk Product Rollouts
professional_superpowers.description: Identifies and reproduces critical issues early so teams can scale product initiatives with greater confidence.

professional_superpowers.name: Build Cross-functional Trust
professional_superpowers.description: Creates confidence across technical and non-technical teams through clear analysis, calm communication and reliable follow-through.

projects.title: Career Copilot
projects.summary: Building an AI-powered platform that helps professionals evaluate job opportunities and transform their career experience into reusable, evidence-based professional content.
projects.business_problem: Professionals often struggle to identify their strongest experience, tailor applications consistently and decide whether a job opportunity is worth pursuing.
projects.objective: Create a structured career knowledge base that can support job matching, resume generation, LinkedIn optimization, cover letters and interview preparation.
responsibilities: Defined the product vision and MVP scope.
Created an initial opportunity scoring system.
Built AI-assisted n8n workflows for CV processing and guided career interviews.
Structured candidate preferences and professional evidence for AI-assisted recommendations.
what_i_learned: How to design a candidate profile as a reusable knowledge model instead of a static resume.
How to build and test API endpoints with FastAPI.
How to integrate external job data into a scoring workflow.
How to build and troubleshoot AI-assisted workflows in n8n.
How to break a product vision into small, testable development steps.

business_impact.intended_value: Reduce the time and uncertainty involved in evaluating and preparing job applications.
